svg.title: Personal AI OS — manage-todo loop
svg.desc: The manage-todo capability maintains the routed to-do list in To-Do.md. Adding: draft all four context parts (what, why it matters, blocks, resolving path) from the conversation, ask at most one clarifying question, link-check the paths, write and validate. A bare file reference is not an item. Completing moves items to Done with the date; reprioritizing reorders. On every load the capability link-checks the paths in items it touches and flags dead ones in place — the rot detector that keeps the list true.
svg.text: manage-todo — the to-do list is routed, never remembered

g.text: the router row loads this capability + To-Do.md
Draft the four parts from context
what · why · blocks · a path that resolves
never a bare write · never an interrogation
Link-check every path the item touches
dead paths flagged in place with ⚠ — the rot detector
order is priority · done moves to ## Done, dated
counts about the vault come from scripts, not the list

svg.text: A bare file reference is not an item. One list at the root; per-project to-dos and rollups are future scope.
